component.name: Opencut Reinforced
component.summary: Edit video locally, with one shared project core

description.p: Opencut Reinforced is a local-first video editor. It imports media, arranges clips on a timeline, edits titles and captions, applies motion and effects, and exports MP4, WebM or lossless video with the FFmpeg runtime bundled in this package.

The project file is owned by a Rust core that the desktop app, the command-line interface and an agent use through the same commands. The app does not upload media anywhere on its own; cloud assistance is opt-in and configured by the user.
Developer Preview with the companion-tool catalog and assistant plans.
